title: Title of playing music is often elided  in the screen locker
line: The lock screen's media controls now widen to show the song title instead of cutting it off at the password field's width.
explanation: The lock screen puts album art, title, artist and the three playback buttons on one row, and that row filled the Loader under the password field, so it was exactly as wide as the password field. With the buttons taking most of that space, nearly any song title was elided even on a wide screen. The row is now centred under the password field and grows to its natural width when the title needs it, capped at 32 grid units (twice the prompt width) and the window width; short titles keep the old layout.

commits.message:
lockscreen: let media controls grow wider than the password field

The media row was always exactly as wide as the password field, so most
song titles were cut short even with plenty of room on screen. The row
now grows around its centre to fit the title, up to twice that width.

BUG: 485540

patches.diff:
From fd6dab3760933746165f3d9b402a8dae1a648201 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:31:04 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen: let media controls grow wider than the password
 field

The media row was always exactly as wide as the password field, so most
song titles were cut short even with plenty of room on screen. The row
now grows around its centre to fit the title, up to twice that width.

BUG: 485540
---
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml | 5 ++++-
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml
index 13bc14f617..4465cd5020 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml
@@ -24,7 +24,10 @@ Item {
         RowLayout {
             id: controlsRow
 
-            anchors.fill: parent
+            anchors.top: parent.top
+            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
+            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
+            width: Math.max(parent.width, Math.min(implicitWidth, Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 32, Window.width - Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2))
             spacing: 0
             enabled: model.canControl
 
--

media.caption: Master: a long title is cut to 'Bohemian Rhapsody...' next to the buttons.
Fixed: the row widens around its centre and shows far more of the very long title, up to the 32-grid-unit cap.
Master: even 'Bohemian Rhapsody (2011 Remaster)' is elided.
Fixed: the same title is shown in full; the row grows only as much as needed.

review.text: Pragmatic, clean QML layout fix in MediaControls.qml that lets the centered media row widen beyond the password field up to 32 grid units (clamped to window width) when the track title needs space, without altering short titles or widening the password input. There is no binding loop because the labels use Text.NoWrap, RTL mirroring and narrow-window clamping are handled safely, and the screenshots plus keyboard/hover checks confirm the improvement without regressions.

reviews.text: Pragmatic, clean QML layout fix in MediaControls.qml that lets the centered media row widen beyond the password field up to 32 grid units (clamped to window width) when the track title needs space, without altering short titles or widening the password input. There is no binding loop because the labels use Text.NoWrap, RTL mirroring and narrow-window clamping are handled safely, and the screenshots plus keyboard/hover checks confirm the improvement without regressions.

The one-line change does show more of the title and the code is sound (no binding loop, Window attached property is in QtQuick in Qt 6). But the row's width now follows the current title's length and is centred, so the previous/play/next buttons jump sideways on every track change (compare after-1 and after-2: Next moves by ~140 px); pressing Next repeatedly with the mouse lands on a different spot each time, which is a real usability regression on the one surface where the controls must stay put. Nate (c3) asked for a layout rethink, and a lopsided row up to twice the password field's width is unlikely to pass VDG as-is.
changes: Keep the playback buttons at a stable position independent of the title length, e.g. put title/artist on their own centred line (allowed to be wider than the password field) with the buttons centred on a separate row, or give the row a fixed width that does not depend on the title.
Re-verify with two tracks of very different title length that the buttons do not move on track change, and post before/after for VDG input given Nate's redesign comment.
